name: ffuf
title: ffuf
description: Web fuzzing with ffuf 2.1: directory and file discovery, virtual hosts, parameters and custom FUZZ positions, with status, size, word and line filters and bundled SecLists wordlists (common, raft-small-dirs, raft-small-files, subdomains-top1mil, params-top) or your own wordlists from /work. Needs network: Full (requests go to the target you name).
license: MIT (MCP server, FuzzingLabs, patched; ffuf; SecLists)

mounts.description: Optional: a folder with your own wordlists (read-only is enough)

notes: Fuzz only systems you are authorized to test. Every argument is validated; a wordlist is a bundled name or a file under /work, never another container path.
